structured_output.what_is_happening: UNTXD ("Untaxed App") is a 37-minute-old Solana token. GMGN says it launched on a Meteora virtual curve and migrated in the same second it was created. The pair being tracked is on PumpSwap, and the packet lists 3 discovered pairs. Price is up about 835–894% in the first hour on roughly $2.1M of volume, against about $77–79k liquidity and about $770k market cap. That is about 28x the liquidity turning over in one hour. Buying is broad (2,094 unique buyers) but selling is concentrated (only 87 unique sellers made about 4,100 sells). That fits a small group of wallets, including 51 wallets GMGN tags as bundlers, distributing into retail buying. At least 10 other tokens use the same name and ticker, all launched within minutes of each other. One of them (9v93…) has more liquidity ($289k vs $79k) and a higher market cap ($964k vs $769k). In the last 5 minutes momentum has flattened: DexScreener shows +1.8% and buys and sells are roughly equal.

More than 10 same-name clones launching in the same window suggests a tweet or announcement set off a race to launch copies. That means there is some real attention, but it is split across many contracts.
